daily_news.title: [NVDA] Oracle denies reports of Abilene data center troubles
daily_news.summary: Investing.com -- Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) pushed back against recent media reports about its flagship Abilene, Texas AI data center, stating that the facility remains on track and that the company has secured the full 4.5 gigawatts of capacity committed to OpenAI. Shares of Oracle last traded down 1.2% at $152.96 in pre-open trading despite the denial amid broader stock market weakness.
